OpenAL Soft 1.25.2, unchanged, from its official binaries (this file is RFA-Mod's note)
=========================================================================================

RFA-Mod's sound engine (src\audio\, rfa_audio.dll) plays sound through OpenAL Soft. This folder holds what it needs of
OpenAL Soft's official Windows binaries, exactly as released:

  Win64\soft_oal.dll   the 64-bit library (the editor's sound preview and the Guerrilla builder's sound check)
  Win32\soft_oal.dll   the 32-bit library (for the game, in a later step)
  include\AL\          its headers (rfa_audio loads the library at run time and finds its functions itself)
  COPYING              its licence: the GNU Library General Public License, version 2 or later
  LICENSE-pffft        the licence of PFFFT, a part of it
  readme.txt           the binaries' own readme

Where it comes from:
  binaries  https://openal-soft.org/openal-binaries/openal-soft-1.25.2-bin.zip
            (SHA-256 67a0c4b800bd860c93c04f38caf8cbe4875f9c84700ac430efc451f70e265434, fetched 2026-11-21)
  source    https://github.com/kcat/openal-soft/tree/1.25.2  (the same version's source code)
  home      https://openal-soft.org/

build.cmd copies the 64-bit soft_oal.dll into bin\editor\ beside rfa_audio.dll, with COPYING as soft_oal-COPYING.txt
and this file as soft_oal-SOURCE.txt. OpenAL Soft is a separate library, loaded at run time; it can be replaced with
any other build of OpenAL Soft (the same name, or renamed OpenAL32.dll).

SHA-256 of the DLLs here:
  Win64\soft_oal.dll  3963b06e319180700be0bcc0d027336664bb3a4975876b4a5442f10746fab5b4
  Win32\soft_oal.dll  606cf8b4c22c7ae00813585279ac045115907bc66d1483eb26355907021ea4b0
